question: Ranking the following glucocorticoids from LOWEST to HIGHEST anti-inflammatory potency, which sequence is correct?

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: This order is reversed. Dexamethasone (25–30×) is far more potent than prednisolone (4×) or hydrocortisone (1×).
Correct! Relative potencies: hydrocortisone = 1, prednisolone = 4, methylprednisolone = 5, dexamethasone = 25–30. Hydrocortisone also has the most mineralocorticoid activity.
Hydrocortisone has lower anti-inflammatory potency than prednisolone. The correct ascending order is hydrocortisone → prednisolone → dexamethasone.
Dexamethasone (potency ~25–30) is more potent than prednisolone (potency ~4), not the other way around.

overallFeedback.feedback: Anti-inflammatory potency (relative to hydrocortisone=1): prednisolone ~4, methylprednisolone ~5, dexamethasone ~25–30. Mineralocorticoid activity decreases as you go up this ladder.
Well done! Remembering the relative potency table (HC=1, Pred=4, Dexa=25) prevents under- or over-dosing in clinical practice.
